title: Bad Bunny Becomes First Latin American Artist to Headline a UK Stadium — Djokovic Cameo, Gorillaz Join for "Tormenta"
detail: Bad Bunny plays two sold-out nights at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28, 2026) — the tour's only UK dates — drawing a combined 104,000 fans and becoming the first Latin American artist to headline a UK stadium. On Night 1 (June 27), Novak Djokovic came on stage briefly to address the roughly 50,000-strong crowd (he did not perform) two days ahead of his Wimbledon opener. On the closing Night 2 (June 28), Gorillaz's Damon Albarn (piano) and Remi Kabaka Jr. (percussion) joined Bad Bunny for a performance of 'Tormenta' and an arrangement of 'Clint Eastwood.' Puerto Rican band Chuwi opened both nights, marking their UK live debut, with 'Cybertruck' and 'Ni Bien Ni Mal' as the exclusive songs across the two shows. The full-scale 'La Casita' Puerto Rican house replica stage returned for both nights.
